Commentary.Commentary: Right then, that is it from the T20I series and it is India who win the series 2-1 and skipper Rohit Sharma celebrates along with his teammates and they pose for a group photo as well. The three-match ODI series is up next and England have a bit of momentum with them. The first ODI will be played at the Kennington Oval in London on Tuesday, the 12th of July. That game begins at 5.30 pm IST (12 pm GMT) but our build-up will begin much sooner. Do join us then, take care and goodbye!

Rohit Sharma, the captain of India says that he thought it was a fantastic chase and even though they fell short, the fight shown by SKY was amazing. Adds that he has watched Suryakumar Yadav for a while now and he loves this format, is very unorthodox and keeps up the tempo. It was important for them to get him into the squad and he has been brilliant. Reckons that there were some places they would have liked to execute better with the ball but England played well. Mentions they bowled well in the Powerplay but the English batters stitched together a good partnership after that and they back themselves to chase any target but it wasn't meant to be. Ends by saying that they are playing good cricket and want to continue playing good cricket and they want to get better with every game. Says it was a great learning curve for them and they need to know how to bat under different circumstances so these types of games are very important.

English skipper, Jos Buttler says it was a fantastic game! He is pleased to win it. Adds Suryakumar Yadav's innings was brilliant. Mentions Reece Topley, Richard Gleeson and Chris Jordan were very good. Credit to Moeen Ali to bowl the second last over, he showed great character. Adds they are blessed with the number of all-rounders they have.
Bhuvneshwar Kumar has been adjudged as the PLAYER OF THE SERIES for his brilliant bowling display in the first couple of games.

Reece Topley (4-0-22-3) is the PLAYER OF THE MATCH for his sensational bowling on a belter of a pitch. Topley says that he is pretty happy to pick up the award when there were some great knocks. Adds that it is about isolating the balls and come up with a plan to either restrict scoring or be aggressive from the start. Mentions that they got the early wickets and it was a brilliant knock from Suryakumar Yadav but they believed that they were always one wicket away from snatching victory. Mentions that Yadav's innings was incredible and he hadn't seen shots like that. Ends by saying that he has had a great start to the white-ball summer and hopes to continue the same.
The presentation ceremony...

Earlier in the day, after electing to bat, a really good effort from Dawid Malan and support from the other batters saw England get to well over 200. They made quick work of the Indian top-order but Suryakumar Yadav played an innings of a lifetime. He got India back into the game but needed support from the others which he did not receive. However, he is the reason why India got so close to the target. In the end, England had enough runs on the board and have got the win that halts Rohit Sharma's winning streak. Stay tuned for the presentation ceremony.

The England bowlers bowled well to every batter of India apart from Suryakumar Yadav. They really struggled to get it right to him and he took advantage of that. Especially the spinners who were taken to the cleaners. However, the quicks, the likes of Richard Gleeson, David Willey and especially Reece Topley had really good figures and that is what helped England win the game.

What a game of cricket that was in the end! Suryakumar Yadav almost pulled off the impossible. This innings was all about him. He walked out when India were two down for not a lot, Rohit Sharma also fell soon after he came out to bat. Suryakumar Yadav though batted brilliantly. Shreyas Iyer first gave good support to him. The two added over 120 runs with Yadav scoring most of the runs. Iyer and Karthik fell at crucial times but Yadav stayed there, got to his ton and made his side believe. The task was a mammoth one where they needed over 40 in the last 2. Yadav did strike a few to begin the penultimate but once he fell, the game was done.

OUT! CLEANED UP! A fabulous delivery to finish off the game by Chris Jordan! This is a pacy yorker, tailing into the off pole. Ravi Bishnoi makes a bit of room looking to cover drive but is undone by raw pace. The ball goes on to hit the base of off stump and England win by 17 runs!
Fullish delivery, around off, Ravi Bishnoi thrashes it through the cover region for a couple of runs.

OUT! CAUGHT! Chris Jordan gets a wicket, his first of the game and India lose their eight. This is very full and on middle, Harshal Patel shuffles across the stumps, trying to scoop it behind but ends up chipping it towards short fine leg. Richard Gleeson over there takes a simple catch and England will not be whitewashed.
Commentary.Howout: c Richard Gleeson b Chris Jordan

Commentary.Commentary: Excellent bowling from Chris Jordan and that should be it! Gets in the yorker at the toes, at good pace too and there's nothing Harshal Patel can do about it other than keep it out.
Full and on the pads, this is clipped away to the man at deep square leg and Harshal Patel denies the run.
Full and straight, this is drilled down to long on for a single.

FOUR! A boundary to end the over and there might still be a chance of a turnaround, a slight chance that is. Around middle, this is swept up and over square leg and the ball runs away into the fence. 21 needed now off 6 balls. With the new rules in place, England are over the time limit and they will have one less fielder outside the 30-yard circle.

OUT! TAKEN! Moeen Ali does have the last laugh and might have just sealed the game for his team. For the first time in this over, Ali does get it full and wide but inside the tramline. At this point Suryakumar Yadav has to go after every delivery and does so but mistimes it badly. The ball is lofted off the toe end of the bat and Philip Salt races in from the long off fence to take a good diving catch. End of a sensational innings from SKY, but it is England who are heading towards victory at the moment.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Moeen Ali

Commentary.Commentary: Quicker and flatter, around off, SKY looks to get inside the line of the ball and paddle it fine but finds the man at short fine leg.
FOUR! Suryakumar Yadav is just making it look so easy. Short and wide, this is slapped away off the back foot through the point region for a boundary.
WIDE! Fuller and wider, Yadav looks to cut but leaves it at the last moment and a wide is called.

SIX! A huge gamble to bowl the off-spinner in the penultimate over and it isn't paying off for England so far. Tossed up, right in the slot and on middle, Yadav extends his arms and thumps it over the long on fence for a biggie. 30 needed now off 10 balls.
FOUR! Goes full and wide again, Suryakumar Yadav goes after it but ends up slicing it over backward point for a much-needed boundary.
WIDE! Moeen Ali tries to bowl quick and wide but spills it beyond the tramline, SKY misses the cut and a wide is called.
Just a single to end an excellent over by Richard Gleeson. Full and straight again, SKY walks across and clips it towards short fine leg for a quick single. 41 needed now off just 12 deliveries.
Misses his mark this time does Gleeson and serves a full toss on middle. Harshal hits it back past the bowler and down to long off for just a single.
Full and straight, Harshal Patel plays it towards extra cover and the batter do not go for the risky single.

OUT! LBW! Richard Gleeson gets in the full ball on leg stump. Ravindra Jadeja tries to have a swipe across the line but misses and gets pinged in front. Huge appeal for lbw and it is given! Ravindra Jadeja reviews it right away though. Was there an inside edge on it? The third umpire checks UltraEdge and finds no bat on it. Ball Tracking goes on to show three reds and the on-field decision will stay. Gleeson gets another timely wicket for England and Suryakumar Yadav is running out of partners. Harshal Patel is the new man in.

SIX! BANG! A juicy full toss from Richard Gleeson, around off and Ravindra Jadeja just holds his shape to time it to perfection. The ball goes over the long off fence and it is a maximum. 43 needed now off 16.
Very full and straight, Jadeja bunts it back to the bowler.
Full and angled into the pads, Jadeja gets an inside edge down to short fine leg for a quick single.

OUT! LBW! Excellent review from the English skipper and David Willey provides a crucial breakthrough. This is on a fuller length, around leg stump and going across the right-hander. Dinesh Karthik walks right across his stumps and tries to flick it over short fine leg but misses and gets rapped on the pads. There is a huge appeal from the bowler but seems to have pitched outside leg. Thre review is taken and there's no spike on UltraEdge. Ball Tracking shows that it is pitching in line and going on to hit the middle of middle stump. 50 needed now off 19 balls. Ravindra Jadeja is the new man at the crease.
Appeal for LBW! The umpire does not agree but England review. Where it pitches could be the real question.
Full and straight, this is lofted down to long on for a run.

FOUR! Magnificent is the word! What a knock this has been from Suryakumar Yadav, shots all around the ground and that too under tremendous pressure, take a bow son. This is full and wide, a low full toss, SKY opens the face of his blade and dissects the fielders at backward point and short third man to pick up a boundary.
On the shorter side and around off, Karthik hangs back and pulls it hard towards deep mid-wicket for just a single.
WIDE! Willey goes for the wide yorker but misses his mark and a wide is called.
FOUR! Hammered! Willey goes full and wide, but slower in pace. Karthik picks it up and then just clears wide mid off with ease to collect a boundary.

FOUR! With just a single in the over, Suryakumar Yadav does get an important boundary for his side off the final delivery. Shorter and wider, SKY backs away and then just opens the face of the bat to slice it away into the fence behind point. 61 needed now off 24 balls.
Eventually, Karthik does get off the mark! Back of a length and around off, Karthik guides it down to third man for a single.
Short of a length and on off stump, Dinesh Karthik looks to pull but mistimes it badly towards mid on. This over is turning the tide back in England's favour.
Just a tad bit short and on a right line around the off pole. Karthik tries to play it off the back foot but gets beaten once again.
On a good length and slanted across the off stump, Dinesh Karthik has a little dab at it but gets beaten past the outside edge.

OUT! CAUGHT BEHIND! England desperately needed a wicket and they have got one. This is banged in short and around leg stump. Shreyas Iyer backs away trying to cut the short ball instead of pulling and ends up getting a bottom edge on it. Jos Buttler takes a good catch in front of him and Reece Topley's excellent outing with the ball continues, he's got three now. Iyer departs after a supporting knock.
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! This is outstanding hitting! How is he hitting those into the crowd? This is full and on middle, almost a yorker. Yadav yet again gets underneath it and carves it over the point fence for a biggie. 66 needed in 30. Well in reach now.
On middle, Iyer walks across and works it through square leg for one.
Goes short and on middle, Yadav is done in by the extra bounce, he mistimes the pull towards square leg for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Yadav is taking the game away from England here. They need his wicket. A full ball on off, this is lofted over covers for a boundary.
FOUR! Nice and fine! Not sure where to bowl to this guy. He can hit a boundary to every part. A full toss on middle, Yadav goes down on one knee and hits it fine on the leg side for a boundary.
Brilliant from Jordan! A yorker on the stumps, it is jammed out on the off side for one.
WIDE! This one is well down the leg side. Left alone. Wided.
Chris Jordan (2-0-16-0) is back on.
Two more and India need 84 in 36. A full toss on the pads, this is worked through mid-wicket for two.
FOUR! It is raining boundaries now! This is a poor ball, a slower one down the leg side, Yadav picks it up and hits it over the keeper's head for a boundary. Another huge over.
Singles won't harm the hosts! Shorter and on the body, this is pulled towards deep square leg for one.
Slower one on off, this is guided through point for one.
SIX! That is an outregeous stroke! Wow! Just magical! Yadav makes room and Gleeson bowls it full and on off, he carves it over point and it goes all the way for a biggie.
A single! On off, this is guided towards point for one.

NOT OUT! Yadav continues to fight! This is tossed up on off, Yadav looks to drive but the ball lands and turns away. Buttler whips the bails off and appeals. It is referred, replays show that Yadav is in. End of a huge over.
SIX! He does and that is the third biggie of the over! 99 needed in 43. India crawling back into the game! Shorter and on middle, this is pulled over the mid-wicket fence for a biggie.
NO BALL! Two more too. On middle, this is worked through square leg for one. Free Hit coming up.
Now looks to play the reverse sweep, this is bowled slow and wide outside off. Iyer swings but misses.
SIX! This is a massive hit! Iyer steps out, he gets to the pitch of the ball and lofts it high and handsome over the long on fence.
Fuller and on off, this is hit down to long off for one.
SIX! Over the fence! Yadav is playing a blinder here! On the pads, thw slog sweep is out. It is hit over square leg for a biggie. Can India make this one into a huge over? 100 up for them.
Yadav makes room and Topley goes full and on middle, this is carved through point for one.
Short and on the body, Iyer is hurried into the pull, it goes on the leg side for one.
On the pads, Iyer misses out as he tries to flick it but misses.
Shortish, Yadab pulls it through mid-wicket for one.
On off, this is pushed down to long off for another single.
Fifty for Yadav! Another brilliant knock from him! He is the one keeping India's slender hopes alive. On middle, he pushes it on the off side and takes one.
A quick run to end! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
FOUR! Up and over! Fuller and on off, this is lofted over the bowler's head for a boundary.
Around off, shortish again, this is guided to point.
Two more! On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for a couple.
On off, this is guided through point for one.
On middle, this is worked through mid-wicket for one.
Around off, this is swept away down to wide long on for a single.
WIDE! Moeen Ali tries to bowl it outside off but this is bowled way too wide, left alone.
Fired in around off, this is pushed out towards covers for a quick single.
Missed opportunity! Floated up outside off, Iyer steps out and hits it hard to the man at extra cover.
SIX! Poor delivery and rightly punished this time. A juicy full toss, on off stump, Iyer launches it high and handsome over the cow corner fence for a maximum.
Short and wide, there to be hit. Shreyas Iyer looks to cut but doesn't make a connection.

Excellent work in the deep from Chris Jordan! Tossed up on middle, Shreyas Iyer dances down the track and whips it towards wide long on. Jordan dives full stretch to his right and keeps the ball in play. Two taken.
Short again, around middle, this is worked away off the back foot and through mid-wicket for a couple of runs. 15 off the over, a good one for India but they need a lot more of these.
A tad shorter and around off, this is defended off the back foot.
FOUR! Powerfully struck! Full and straight, this is jabbed down to the wide long on on fence for another boundary.
WIDE! Spilled down leg, Yadav misses the flick and a wide is called.
FOUR! Drifted onto the pads, Suryakumar Yadav gets down on one knee and scoops it over the vacant backward square leg region to pick up a second boundary of the over.
A bit of yes and no in the middle but no harm is done. On a shorter length and on middle, Yadav nudges it out on the off side and looks for the single but Iyer sends him back.
FOUR! Quick hands from Suryakumar Yadav and he gets it through. Quicker and flatter, around off, Yadav cuts it past the man at point for a boundary.
Full and straight, firmly hit by Iyer but straight towards mid on.
Slower one, sliding onto the pads, Yadav tickles it down to fine leg and collects a run.
FOUR! Up and over! Length ball, around the top of off, Suryakumar Yadav just hangs back and lifts it over extra cover for a boundary.
On the bounce! Short of a length and over off, Shreyas Iyer backs away and carves it towards the man at third man for a run.
Goes a bit wider Jordan and bowls it on the fifth stump line, Iyer defends it out towards cover-point.
Starts off with a good-length ball on off, this is crisply driven towards deep cover for a single. 50 up for India now.
Slower delivery, on a length and on off. Shreyas Iyer just pushes it into the vacant mid-wicket region and races back for the second. Good running.
Around middle and leg, this is whipped away in front of mid-wicket for a single.
Fuller and going across the right-hander, Iyer looks to drive but gets it off the inner half of the bat towards short fine leg. A single is taken.
Length, angling across the off stump, Yadav moves across and works it leg side for one.
SIX! Oh, nonchalantly done! Length ball around middle and leg, SKY just gets on one knee and clips it over the backward square leg fence for a maximum. Just remarkable how easy he made that look.
FOUR! Nicely placed! Willey goes full and wide, Suryakumar Yadav just drives it past point and beats the man at the point fence for a boundary.
Another quick and easy single. Pitched up on off, Yadav punches it straight to mid off and sets off for the run. At the end of the Powerplay, India are reeling at 34/3!
A touch fuller and on off, Iyer wrists it towards wide mid on and picks up a single.
Leg bye! Full again, on the pads this time. Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick it away but misses. The ball goes off the pads and past the keeper as they sneak in a leg bye.
Goes fuller this time and angles it into middle and leg, this is firmly pushed towards mid on.
Good length, outside off and zipping through. SKY looks to thrash it through covers but gets beaten past the outside edge.
Length delivery on off stump, Suryakumar Yadav drives off the front foot but finds the fielder at extra cover.

OUT! Straight to the man! Rohit walks back now and the game is slipping away quickly from the visitors! Short and on middle, another slower one. Holds in the surface. Sharma is early in the pull, it goes off the toe-end towards deep mid-wicket. It is taken by Salt.
Commentary.Howout: c Philip Salt b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: A slower one, shorter. Sharma looks to pull but misses to get hit on the body.
FOUR! Second boundary in the over for Rohit! This is easy for him! On the pads, it is whipped over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Outside off, this is guided down to third man for one.
WIDE! Buttler felt it had hit something! On the pads, Yadab looks to whip it but misses. Buttler starts appealing but the umpire signals a wide.
Direct hit but the batter is well in! Fuller and on off, Sharma strokes it towards mid off and takes one.
FoUR! Up and over! Rohit looks to step on the gas now! Fuller and outside off, this is lofted over the mid off fielder for a boundary.
FOUR! Finds the gap this time! Fuller and on off, this is driven through covers for a boundary.
Shorter and outside off, Yadav slashes but misses.
Shorter and on off again, Yadav pushes it towards cover but no runs taken.
On off, this is pushed to covers for one.
Angled into middle, Suryakumar Yadav looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early, it goes off a soft leading edge to covers.
On middle, defended.
Another dot! On off, this is pushed to covers.
Yadav is off the mark! On the pads, this is clipped through square leg for one.

OUT! TAKEN! Kohli walks back! Once again he was looking good but has given it away! He steps out again and makes room. Willey drags the length back and bowls it outside off. Kohli slaps it but straight to covers where it is taken by Roy.
Commentary.Howout: c Jason Roy b David Willey

Commentary.Commentary: SIX! Over the fence! Kohli seems in the mood here! This is full and on middle, it is lofted over the bowler's head for a biggie. 10 from the last two balls.
FOUR! First boundary of the chase and it comes off the bat of Kohli! On middle, this is whipped over mid-wicket after taking a few steps down the track. A boundary.
Kohli looks to come down the track and make room but Willey bowls a yorker, it is jammed back to the bowler.
A loud appeal but turned down! Pitched outside leg. On the pads, Sharma looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. End of a brilliant first over from Reece Topley!
Off the splice! Shorter and on middle, gets big on Rohit. He looks to pull but it goes off the splice to mid-wickiet.
Good length and on off, defended.
On the pads, Kohli works it down to fine leg and gets to the other end. He is off the mark.
Back of a length and on off, Kohli pushes it to covers.

OUT! PANT SIGNALS FOR THE DRS BUT THE TIME RUNS OUT! He has to walk back and England strike early! He has been given out caught behind and had he not hit it, he should have gone upstairs straightaway. Rohit was probably worried about the LBW and hence, was hesitant in asking him to go up but the impact seemed high. Excellent start for Topley who comes back into the side and strikes. This is angled into the body, Pant looks to heave it on the leg side. It goes off something to the keeper who takes it and appeals. The finger is raised. Pant indicates he did not hit it, Rohit asks him where did it hit him on the pad. Eventually time runs out and India have lost their opener. Virat Kohli walks out to bat! Can the great man deliver when his side needs him too?
Commentary.Howout: c Jos Buttler b Reece Topley

Commentary.Commentary: A dot to end! A tidy over from Willey to begin with! Length and on off, this is pushed to mid off.
Pant gets off the mark! On middle, he walks across and works it towards mid-wicket for one.
This is a beauty! Length and on off, this one shapes away. Pant is drawn into the stroke, he gets beaten.
Another one on a length and around off, this is guided to point.
Pant wanted to get off the mark there! Length and on off, Pant drops it towards cover and calls for one but is sent back.
India and Rohit are underway! Fuller and on off, this is pushed to mid off for one.
